Reasons To Start Buying Bonds

Anatole Kaletsky

Gavekal Research | 6 Oct 2026

Five years into the worst bear market in government bonds since the 1970s, is it finally time to buy bonds? In contrast to most of my colleagues at Gavekal, my answer is “yes”. I say this as someone who has consistently urged investors to avoid all G7 bond markets since early 2022, when the combination of the Ukraine war and Covid caused what I consider a once-in-a-lifetime global “regime change” towards a more inflationary environment that is bound to force interest rates higher for years or even decades ahead.Why then do I now disagree with Charles, who remains unequivocally bearish about the US, UK and French bond markets (see Not All Bond Markets Are Equal), and also with Will, who still sees bonds as unattractive or at best neutral (see Are US Long Bonds A Buy? (Part IV)) in terms of their underlying economic value?
